surface: Native front-cover concept at source size and actual thumbnail widths; not browser or print proof
audience: Adult fantasy readers; creator's stated 29-year-old reader profile

direction.keep: Three people, raised physical path, dark title field, exact edition title
direction.avoid: Invented byline, unsupported print claims, title collision with water-frame rim, cropped hands
direction.signature: Level two-line literary title above a human-scale choice
direction.system: Editable JSON layout; native Pango type over unchanged generated source; licensed Newsreader

asset_quality.why_premium: Native designed typography over an existing generated source with licensed type. Schema has no native typesetting method; unknown is retained rather than mislabeling this as new generated media or a browser capture. Source artwork retains its own prior staging provenance.
asset_quality.context_scope: Actual native PNG at 992 and 420 pixels plus 120-pixel comparison. No browser, print or independent proof.

artifacts.kind: native cover proof at reading width

checks.name: source-integrity
checks.notes: Original raster hash, dimensions and edition identity pinned; original asset untouched.

checks.name: native-typography
checks.notes: Official TTF and full OFL pinned; fallback caught and corrected; actual font has distinct metrics.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.notes: Native PNG only. Refined title clears bright rim; faces, hands and path preserved. Small ancillary labels not certified readable at 120 px.

checks.name: automated-contracts
checks.notes: Eight cover-proof and six artbook tests; not visual or literary approval.

checks.name: browser-qa
checks.notes: Local file URL rejected by browser security policy. No workaround attempted; offline native typesetting is separate from browser rendering.

checks.name: motion
checks.notes: Static native proof; no web motion changed.

checks.name: independent-review
checks.notes: PP holds new swarms; no alternate reviewer dispatch.

checks.name: release
checks.notes: Private proof. Title, byline, casting, rights, print specification, independent critique and production approval remain open.

score.assessor: maker only; diagnostic, not independent approval
